source.snippet: I have a Platform Event trigger that needs to make a request to an authenticated API using Named/External Credentials. However, the Automated Process User, the default running user for Platform Event triggers, does not have access to External Credentials. I have found two possible solutions: Deploy PlatformEventSubscriberConfig... Assign a Permission set...

problem_statement: Salesforce developers repeatedly hit undocumented permission walls when configuring automated integrations (Platform Events + External Credentials), wasting hours on trial-and-error with no clear official guidance.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and admins at SMB and enterprise companies building automated integrations on the Salesforce platform
notes: Business context strong — Salesforce work is paid professional/enterprise work. Buyer: companies paying Salesforce licenses and developer time. Pain is configuration complexity and undocumented permission edge cases. Possible product angle: Salesforce integration diagnostic/guided-setup tool. Single signal but highly specific technical pain that recurs across the Salesforce ecosystem.
